hints.text: When you press the up arrow key, the rocket changes position.
hints.title: Event 1

hints.text:
This command sets the position of the sprite on the stage using coordinates.
1. Place the sprite in a certain place, and the command "Go to x: __ y: __" will contain the coordinate values corresponding to that position.
2. Drag the "Go to x: __ y: __" block from the command palette.
hints.title: Motion 1

hints.text: When you press the down arrow key, the rocket again changes position.
hints.title: Event 2

hints.text: Move the sprite to a different position, and then new values will appear in the "go to x: __ y: __" command.
hints.title: Motion 2

presentation.text: Program the rocket to move between two points when you press the up arrow and down arrow keys!
presentation.title: Teleport

hints.text:
Move the star anywhere and use the command "Go to X __ Y __", and do it 4 times.
Use different coordinates for the command "Go to X __ Y __"
hints.title: Motion

hints.text: Use the command "wait __ sec" between position changes, so that they become visible!
hints.title: Delay

presentation.text: The star appears randomly in multiple places.
presentation.title: Star

hints.text:
Change the position of the moon 3 times.
You already know how to set a position. Do it yourself!
hints.title: Motion

hints.text: Don't forget to use the command "wait __ sec" between movements.
hints.title: Delay

presentation.text: Did you notice that the moon moves across the sky? Let's program it!
presentation.title: Moon

hints.text:
We can only change one coordinate.
The X coordinate changes the position of the sprite left-right. Change the position of the crab 5 times.
hints.title: The "set x to __" command

presentation.text: This crab moves sideways! Look, only the X coordinate changes.
presentation.title: Crab

hints.text:
This command moves the sprites up and down by changing the Y coordinate.
Set the red marker, so that the thermometer shows a high temperature.
hints.title: Hot!

hints.text:
Let's have the thermometer report the temperature.
Instead of the command to wait, use the command to say "Hot!"
hints.title: Delay

hints.text:
Set the red marker, so that the thermometer reads a little over 20 degrees.
Don't forget that our thermometer notifies about the temperature.
hints.title: Warm

hints.text:
Set the red marker, so that the thermometer reads just under 10 degrees.
Don't forget that our thermometer notifies about the temperature, and at this temperature, it is "Cool!"
hints.title: Cool

hints.text:
Set the red marker, so that the thermometer reads about -10 degrees.
Don't forget that our thermometer notifies about the temperature.
hints.title: Cold

hints.text:
Set the red marker, so that the thermometer reads about -30 degrees.
Don't forget that our thermometer notifies about the temperature.
hints.title: Freezing

presentation.text: Move the red marker up and down by changing the Y coordinate.
presentation.title: Thermometer

hints.text: When you press the number "1," the red light is on. One gray circle should cover the green, and the other should cover the yellow.
hints.title: Red light

hints.text: When you press the number "2," the yellow light is on. One gray circle should cover the green, and the other should cover the red.
hints.title: Yellow light

hints.text: When you press the number "3," the green light is on. One gray circle should cover the red, and the second one should cover the yellow.
hints.title: Green light

presentation.text:
Cover the not-working colors with a gray circle and move it to the right place!
Press the keys 1,2,3
presentation.title: Traffic light

hints.title: The sun glides to multiple points

presentation.text: Watch how smoothly the sun moves across the sky!
presentation.title: Sun
